You choose a person, not a brand

Safe Oasis is led by an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker recognised by the AASW — offering trauma-informed, culturally responsive support in English and Turkish.

Send a confidential enquiry How we can help

Safe Oasis is led by Zeynep Korkmaz — an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker recognised by the AASW. In this field, people don’t choose a brand; they choose a person they feel safe with.

Safe Oasis provides evidence-based therapeutic support, psychosocial assessment, advocacy and professional reporting, led by an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker recognised by the AASW. The practice is person-centred, trauma-informed, culturally responsive and strengths-based.

Our approach

We meet you where you are, at a pace that feels safe. We won’t rush you, pressure you, or promise outcomes we can’t control. We’ll listen carefully, explain your options in plain language, and work with your strengths.

  • Trauma-informed — safety, choice and control are built into every conversation.
  • Culturally responsive — your culture, identity, faith and language are respected, not sidelined.
  • Strengths-based — we build on what’s already working for you.
  • Bilingual — genuine support in English and Turkish.

If you need help right now

Safe Oasis is not an emergency or crisis service. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, please call 000. For 24/7 support, these free, confidential services can help.
